name: Prosciutto di Parma, Mozzarella & Tomato Bruschetta (Let the Magic Begin Menu)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
whyItWorks: Thin Prosciutto di Parma and fresh mozzarella over toasted ciabatta are low-fiber once roasted pepper/tomato skins are pushed aside.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the prosciutto, fresh mozzarella (with a Lactaid), and bread; scrape off the fire-roasted bell pepper skins if flaring.
watchOuts: Roasted bell pepper and tomato skins
